stages.description: Offsets are milliseconds from the run start (the earliest sample start). Stages are sorted by from_offset_ms after parsing and must not overlap (touching is allowed, gaps are allowed). Ids must be unique and at least one stage must have the role steady; the runtime rejects the violations with DUPLICATE_STAGE_ID, OVERLAPPING_STAGES and STAGES_NO_STEADY.

offset.description: Milliseconds from the run start; at most 7 days.

id.description: The id of a steady stage is the window_id of the evaluated window.

role.description: steady becomes an evaluated window; excluded only names a part of the run that is left out (there is no automatic role).

to_offset_ms.description: Must be greater than from_offset_ms. The end of a steady stage past the end of the run is clipped to the run end and reported as clipped_to_run_end.
